summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of the remaining 51% equity interest in I-Systems Soluções de Infraestrutura S.A. for a final purchase price of R$947 million, making I-Systems a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction was initially disclosed in a Material Fact on February 11, 2026, and closed on May 6, 2026, after all conditions precedent were satisfied. Terms and conditions remain as previously disclosed. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The deal was structured as a cash acquisition of the minority stake, eliminating any remaining overhang. As the acquisition is already closed, there is no ongoing risk-arb angle; watch for integration updates and potential synergies.
